About

I am a Predoctoral Research Associate at King’s College London. I hold an M.A. in Economics from Azim Premji University, Bengaluru, and a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from Government Degree College, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh. Previously, I have worked as a Research Associate with researchers at Harvard University and the Madras Institute of Development Studies (MIDS), and the Center for Asian Democracy at the University of Louisville. I have also worked as a Research Intern at the Centre for the Study of the Indian Economy (CSIE), and the Azim Premji Foundation. My CV is here.

Primary fields:
Development Economics, Labour Economics

Secondary fields:
Environmental Economics, Agricultural Economics
